Own full-game, team, half, and quarter totals in Demon. Consume historical baselines, verified game flow, market lines, timestamps, and freshness. Preserve DETECTED, WATCH, ARMED, ACTIONABLE, DECAYING, EXPIRED, and SUPPRESSED lifecycle semantics. Suppress stale, conflicting, unmapped, suspended, illiquid, incomplete, or low-confidence inputs; ACTIONABLE is never a guarantee.
